description: S459 LOW-MED-3: a union with a refined member judges EVERY member — none is admitted wholesale. `date` / `timestamp` are registered string-shaped primitives and are judged as strings; a value-native map member is judged by its map shape. -5 inhabits none of `number(>0)`, `date`, `timestamp`, `[string: number]`, so each cell write (and the `pick(v: number(>0) | date)` parameter) throws E-CONTRACT-001-RT and the cells keep 1. Before the fix each of those members judged `true`, and -5 was admitted.
rationale: §53.11: "The compiler SHALL emit a runtime check for every boundary-zone assignment that it cannot statically elide." A check whose member arm is `true` admits every value. SPEC (the canonical-empty list): "`date` / `timestamp` (registered string-shaped primitives)".
